# Parity fixtures

Generated by RUNNING the Python recorder (`scripts/skywatch-recorder.py`, last present at commit `121e08f`) on the inputs in `*-in.json`; the `*-out.json`
files are what it produced. `server/test/parity.test.ts` feeds the same inputs to the Node modules and compares the parsed outputs.

- `wx-*`: `wx_pack()` (weather packing)
- `sample*-*`: `sample()` (one history row + polar bins), `append-*`: the retention / polar merge in `main()`
- `moves-*`, `airports.json`: `MovementTracker.update()` over a scripted scenario (landing, take-off from the ground, take-off first seen climbing, landing inferred from a lost track, stale and duplicate suppression); the airport rows are three OurAirports rows
- `alert-*`, `quiet-hours.json`, `ascii-header.json`: `alert_reason`, `alert_message`, `AlertState`, `in_quiet_hours`, `alerts_tick`, `alerts_config`

To regenerate: check out `121e08f`, run the generator that was kept at `.private/gen-fixtures.py` (not in the repository), or compare against `git show 121e08f:scripts/skywatch-recorder.py`.
